name: Harbour Drone Symphony
promptTemplate: A synchronized fleet of {{drone_count}} glowing drones performing a {{formation_mode}} over night waters with {{palette_theme}} illumination and {{water_clarity}} harbour reflections.

ui.title: HARBOUR DRONES
ui.tagline: Synchronized aerial light show over night water

palette_theme.hint: Recolour drone beacons and water glow

drone_count.hint: Scale the fleet density in the sky

water_clarity.hint: Shift surface ripples and reflection smear

listing.blurb: Hundreds of glowing drones ease between rotating 3D formations over a dark harbor, casting trembling reflections across the water.
listing.prompt: A drone light show over a dark harbour: a few hundred glowing points fly smoothly between formations -- a rotating globe, a giant heart, a spiral, a whale breaching -- easing along paths that never cross, their reflections trembling in the water below. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
